verdict.rationale: Pipecat's own docs say you can swap speech services among 200+ integrated providers, usually with one line of code, which supports plugging in different TTS providers. However, the evidence never names TTS providers or voice selection, so the voice-choice half of the story is unshown. Missing for 10: an explicit list of TTS providers, documentation of a voice library or per-provider voice selection, and hands-on corroboration of swapping TTS voices.

support.subject: As a developer, I can choose from a broad voice library or plug in multiple TTS providers to get the voice I want

citations.quote: Swap speech, language, and vision services from any of 200+ integrated providers and services — usually one line of code.
Orchestrate 150+ AI services with ultra-low latency.
check out any provider they support, and it can be easily onboarded in a few lines of code.
